I'll do that, but then the GH diff shows the validation code as removed and added 😄
let's drop the double-generation for v1beta1 ... we expect to use v1 as our hub type from k8s.io/apiserver and the webhook authorizer
let's follow the pattern of staging/src/k8s.io/api/resource/v1/doc.go and double generate *only* the stable version and generate to k8s.io/api ...

the problem I ran into later wrt double-generating is visible here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137633/changes#r3864640349

`k8s.io/api/authorization/v1alpha1` which vendors `k8s.io/api/authorization/v1.ConditionsAwareDecision` chooses to use the "canonical" validation function from `k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/authorization` instead of this peer one.

With not doing any double generation, but instead authoritatively moving the validation generation to `k8s.io/api` like is done now in the PR, #137633 rebased on top is now green 👍 

Of course moving the validation from one place to the other is slightly riskier than double-generating, but given that double-generating didn't work (at least in a straightforward manner), it might be worth it. Regardless of where the authoritative validation code is, it writes into exactly the same schemebuilder, so the only thing that changes is that now folks outside of `k/k` will also have the v1 (only) declarative validation funcs registered in the scheme.

cc @yongruilin @jpbetz for visibility to the generation issue trying to call "canonical" declarations inside kubernetes/kubernetes from staging repos.

> the only thing that changes is that now folks outside of k/k will also have the v1 (only) declarative validation funcs registered in the scheme.

I'd prefer to fix the generation issue rather than inconsistently auto-register a single group/version's stuff into the scheme from within k8s.io/api

to unblock this PR without doing strange things with auto-scheme registration in init() functions in k8s.io/api, we'll mark the cross-package field used from v1alpha1 as opaque to declarative validation for now and manually call the double-generated validation function under k8s.io/api directly.

---

@yongruilin, when we have double-generation, it would be ideal for the generator to make cross-package calls prefer the generated version that lives in the same module

concretely, we're double-generating validation for authorization/v1 to:
* pkg/apis/authorization/v1
* k8s.io/api/authorization/v1 (with no scheme registration)

then we're referencing that type from authorization/v1alpha1 and double generating validation for *that* to:
* pkg/apis/authorization/v1alpha1
* k8s.io/api/authorization/v1alpha1 (with no scheme registration)

and we want the functions in k8s.io/api/authorization/v1alpha1 to prefer calling the functions in k8s.io/api/authorization/v1 (instead of k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/authorization/v1 which import rules don't allow)

Have a branch for this — cross-package calls will prefer the nearest generated copy over the canonical one, so k8s.io/api/authorization/v1alpha1 resolves to k8s.io/api/authorization/v1. Will open a follow-up PR; no need to hold this one.
That's great, thanks @yongruilin! I worked around it now in this PR, but I'd be happy to revert that part whenever ready.
